ios.desc:
Discover Your Perfect Japanese Dining Experience

Navigate Japan's incredible food scene with our expertly curated restaurant guide. Featuring multiple "Top 100" rankings across essential categories - from sushi to ramen, kaiseki to modern fusion - find exactly what you're craving.

Smart filters help you discover the perfect spot:

Map view
Price ranges to match your budget
Payment methods accepted (credit cards, digital payments, cash)
Business Hours
Official website and social media accounts
Cuisine categories
Multiple languages support (English, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Thai, Tagalog, Malay, Vietnamese)

Our location-based search makes it easy to find acclaimed restaurants wherever you are in Japan. Each restaurant profile includes detailed information about pricing, accepted payment methods, and more (features coming in the future versions) to help you plan your visit.
Whether you're a local food enthusiast or exploring Japan, find your next memorable meal with confidence. From casual neighborhood gems to distinguished fine dining, discover Japan's diverse culinary landscape tailored to your preferences.

Note: Please verify restaurant information directly before visiting as details may change.

quotes.text:
Japan Top 100 (restaurants) app

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/japan-top-100/id6741251616

Only public on iOS store for now, due to Google requires larger # of testers to authenticate the app.

This app idea came from my last Japan trip. I had a hard time finding good local restaurants (not tourist traps). So I decided to build this app with Japanese-oriented lists, due to lists' lacked of maps, etc. The app actually helped me discover some great spots, since it lists places all over Japan. Please give it a try and let me know if you have any feature requests or ideas.
quotes.story_title: Ask HN: What are you working on? (March 2025)
